title: Evaluate Valid Expressions
summary: Evaluate a valid nested expression consisting of signed integer literals and add(a,b), sub(a,b), mul(a,b), or div(a,b). Arguments can themselves be expressions. Return its integer result. All divisions are exact and intermediate results fit a long integer.
